verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/HR SaaS platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API keys, tokens, permission scopes, or service accounts. The help-center material covers only UI workflows (payroll, time off, Xero mapping), and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. The 'Connect Xero' login flow authorizes Justworks to reach Xero; it is not Justworks issuing scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.
